## Entity (verbatim)
GenMyo is an inner wellness platform delivered entirely through WhatsApp. Its core experience, The Mirror Project by GenMyo, is a guided reflection — a few honest questions, asked slowly, that help you reconnect with yourself and see what's actually going on. Not therapy. Not another app. No advice. GenMyo is not therapy, not a diagnostic tool, and not a crisis service.
